item.title: Structured Primary Keys
item.description:
Structured Primary Keys

Sometimes I hit a wall when optimizing a client’s query. Over the years, I realized that most cases fall into two categories: (1) unreasonable expectations based on the cloud bill, not on the infrastructure’s power; (2) the primary key design. This article explains how primary keys can put tables into walled gardens so that the database schema falls apart into disconnected pieces, effectively disabling SQL’s set-based powers.
